jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: Location : Fully Remote (Global) Classification : Full-time; 40 hours per week Pay Range : €51,000-90,000 Experience : 2+ years as a QA engineer Welcome to Miaplaza! Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy , Always Icecream , and Clever Dragons , and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School . Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀 ▶️ You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future ! How you’ll make an impact (position summary): Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful! The Role We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle. You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases. As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool. A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time. What You'll Do Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet) Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4) How We Work We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer. We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality: Meetings (yes, we keep them minimal): Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other.. Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint. 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda. Monthly Engineering all-hands. That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work. Deployments: Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release. Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes Communication: Async-friendly. Documentation-first. Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion Google Workspace for email and documents. Zoom for video calls. Timezone: We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet. What We're Looking For Requirements (Requisite Skills): 2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing 2+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer) 2+ years of experience using TypeScript Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklis

jobs.title: Staff QA Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately. Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific. Group Overview This role sits within the Digital and Synthetic Group (D&S). The D&S Group is committed to providing mission-driven information solutions that seamlessly bridge the digital and physical realms. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies and advanced platforms, we empower operational readiness and elevate situational awareness across diverse domains—including air, maritime, and space. Position Summary Metrea is seeking a dynamic, curious, and highly-motivated Staff QA Engineer to join our software development team, building software solutions that provide geospatial data processing and visualisations. Candidates should have strong experience with the software development lifecycle, and extensive skills and knowledge in quality engineering. The position involves helping to drive product delivery, in collaboration with Product Managers, Software Engineers and other QA Engineers. Metrea is a people-first organisation and candidates should have strong communication skills and a desire to proactively elevate their team through continuous knowledge sharing, collaboration, feedback, and mentorship. What You'll Do Assist the team with refinement of user stories, through a testing lens Define test strategy for complex products and projects Work with product and engineering to clarify acceptance criteria Scope and write test cases Estimate test effort associated with user stories Execute manual software tests Help define and execute the team's test strategy Create and maintain test plans and appropriate documentation Create and maintain automation scripts Support other testers and developers with broader system testing Champion Quality Engineering best practices Coordinate and collaborate with Testers across teams What You Bring
